text.body: ॥ gaṅgādharastotram ॥ kṣīrāmbhonidhimanthanodbhavaviṣātsandahyamānān surān brahmādīnavalokya yaḥ karuṇayā hālāhalākhyaṃ viṣam । niśśaṅkaṃ nijalīlayā kabalayanlokānnarakṣādarādārtatrāṇaparāyaṇassabhagavān gaṅgādharo megatiḥ।। 1 kṣīraṃ svādu nipīya mātulagṛhebhuktvā svakīyaṃ gṛhaṃ kṣīrālābhavaśena khinnamanaseghoraṃ tapaḥ kurvate । kāruṇyādupamanyaveniravadhiṃ kṣīrāṃbudhiṃ dattavānārtatrāṇa parāyaṇassabhagavān gaṅgādharo me gatiḥ ।। 2 mṛtyuṃ vakṣasi tāḍayannijapadadhyānaikabhaktaṃ muniṃ mārkaḍeyamapālayatkaruṇayā liṃgādvinirgatya yaḥ । netrāmbhojasamarpaṇenaharayebhīṣṭaṃ rathāṅgaṃ dadā vārtātrāṇa parāyaṇassabhagavān gaṅgādharo me gatiḥ ।। 3 oḍhuṃ droṇajayadrathādirathikaissainyaṃ mahatkairavaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasahāyavantamapi taṃ bhītaṃ prapannārtihā । pārthaṃ rakṣitavā namoghaviṣaya divyāstra mudbodhayannārta...।। 4 bālaṃ śaivakulodbhavaṃ parihasatsvajñātipakṣākulaṃ khidyantaṃ tava mūrdhni puṣpanicayaṃ dātuṃ samudyatkaram । dṛṣṭvā namyaviriñciramyanagare pūjāṃ tvadīyāṃ bhajannārta ...॥ 5 saṃtrasteṣu purā surāsurabhayādindrādibṛndārakeṣvārūḍho dharaṇīrathaṃ śrutihayaṃ kṛtvā murāriṃ śaram । rakṣanyaḥ kṛpayā samastavibudhāt jitvā purārīn kṣaṇā dārtatrāṇa...॥ 6 śrautasmārtapatho parāṅbhuvamapi prodyanmahāpātakaṃ viśvādhīśamapatyameva gatirityālāpavantaṃ sakṛt । rakṣanyaḥ karuṇāpayonidhiriti prāptaprasiddhiḥ purā hyārtratāṇa...॥ 7 gāṅgaṃ vegamavāpyamānyavibudhaissoḍhuṃ purā yācito dṛṣṭvābhaktabhagīrathena vinato rudrojaṭāmaṇḍale। kāruṇyā davanītale suranadīmāpūrayanpāvanī mārtatrāṇa parāyaṇa...॥ 8 ॥ iti śrīmadapparayyadīkṣitaviracitaṃ śrīgaṅgādharāṣṭakam ॥
